system.description:
You lean into the "caster" half of the hybrid — less committed to the blade, more willing to cast outright when the moment calls for it.

  • Broader Study: Each time you gain access to a new spell level, add one Wizard-list spell of that level to your Magus list (not Polymorph; Haste on yourself only).
  • You still use the Magus's slot progression and DC.
  • After you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, your next weapon attack before the end of your next turn has Advantage.
